It’s surprising how many students believe that NID NIFT & UCEED are the only pathways into design.

Yet many students never learn about these options because they are only guided toward the most commonly known exams or given options with hefty fee structure.

Character Rotation: Building Real Design Skills

Character rotation is more than drawing the same character from different angles. It helps students understand form, proportion, structure, volume, and spatial visualization which are essential skills used in animation, game design, illustration and product design.

This exercise teaches students how to think in 3D and maintain consistency across every view of a character.

Good Design colleges select students based on their skills, creative thinking, observation, and problem-solving abilities, not shortcuts. 

Shortcuts may produce quick results, but they don’t build strong pedigree. A college’s pedigree is defined by the quality of its students, the rigor of its training and the achievements of its alumni.

While AI and digital tools can enhance creativity, they are most effective when built upon strong foundational skills. First develop the ability to draw, observe, visualize and design. Then use advanced tools to push your ideas even further.
